name: Ravi
label: Frustrated playlist-bug troubleshooter
who: I use Spotify on my phone and Xbox, mostly through playlists and my Liked Songs. I have been on both free and Premium, and when playlists stop playing what I picked, I start looking at other apps.
value_for_money: Says price matters: switched to Spotify from YouTube Music because of premium prices [13], and is annoyed that prices went up [8]. Premium lapsed after a card problem and playlists were left empty [33], and they later moved from Premium to free [25]. Welcomed the free-tier update that lets users choose any song [30].
loyalty: Keeps Spotify because of years of playlists, Liked Songs and downloads [8][38], and Release Radar [10]. Has switched in both directions when playback broke: away from YouTube Music [13] and to Apple Music [39].
pain_points: Playlists play recommended or random songs instead of the ones picked
Liked Songs genre filter does not stick
Playlists lose songs or go empty, including after Premium lapses
Album tracks come out of order, or songs cannot be picked
likes: Being able to choose any song on the free tier
reasons_to_stay: They say Release Radar is one of the things they like most about Spotify [10], and their years of Liked Songs and downloads are a strong reason to stay [8][38]. Scrobbling and the cost of Premium were the reasons they moved to Spotify from YouTube Music [13].
tone: Frustrated but direct, reporting bugs in short, specific detail and asking whether others see them too.
